title_b: Intermittent Fasting in Metabolic Syndrome: Clinical Evidence, Molecular Mechanisms, and Future Perspectives
findings_b: Important unresolved controversies cover protocol optimization, long-term adherence, and inter-individual metabolic variability. findings_a: The results of previous studies raised a lot of interest in the role of fish oil and omega-3 fatty acids in primary and secondary prevention of cardiovascular diseases. Since recently published trials in patients with coronary artery diseases or post-myocardial infarction did not show an effect of omega-3 fatty acids on major cardiovascular endpoints, this review will examine the limitations of those data and suggest recommendations for the use of omega-3 fatty acids.
